verdict.rationale: Pigment is a SaaS platform that mentions open APIs and an Audit Trail API, so an interactive API reference is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack shows no API explorer, try-it console, or runnable API examples, and the probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any candidate path. The function library's examples cover modeling formulas, not the API, so they are an adjacent feature and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
